supersedes: test40_retrieval_answer_cost_v1 for manuscript coupling analysis only
l3_aggregation: equal mean of the three canonical GPT-5.1 question-level scores

primary_descriptive_comparisons: final-answer quality grouped by no, partial, or full required-gold retrieval
within-question BGE-LLM minus Hybrid and BGE retrieval and L3 differences
retrieval_answer_coupling.primary_correlation: Spearman correlation between raw required_gold_recall@10 and raw final-answer quality across 114 question-system observations
retrieval_answer_coupling.confidence_interval: percentile 95% interval from 10000 bootstrap replicates sampled by question, retaining all three system observations for each sampled question
retrieval_answer_coupling.evidence_use_proxy: a unique required-gold final chunk is visibly cited by its C-number in the answer; L1 required_gold_retrieved counts evidence records and can exceed the number of unique chunks
retrieval_answer_coupling.interpretation_boundary: associations and deterministic transitions are descriptive, not causal

failure_paths.majority_error_rule: at least two of three L3 repeats flag a material error, boundary violation, or contradicted core claim
failure_paths.citation_scope_mismatch_flag: L1.5 reports at least one unsupported or contradicted cited claim

cost_performance.formal_retriever_comparison: tagger plus answer generation for all systems, plus selector for BGE-LLM
cost_performance.cost_basis: frozen per-call estimated_cost_usd or frozen generation usage summary
